Media. media.import(project_id,path,kind)->{id,project_id,kind,sha256,path,status:VALID}, kind image or video. Current milestone M2:
Evidence Import and Signals. Reuse M1 projects. evidence.import(project_id,path) reads an existing bounded local directory or Git working directory without executing source files, following symlinks outside it, or reading .git internals/secrets. It returns {id,project_id,source_path,version,sha256,status,files:[{path,sha256,text}]}; relative paths are stable, digest is SHA-256 of actual content (64 lowercase hex; aggregate algorithm documented). Unchanged refresh keeps the same version identity. evidence.refresh(project_id,evidence_id) rereads the stored path: changed bytes create a new id/version and mark the prior record status=SUPERSEDED. evidence.get(project_id,evidence_id) returns historical/current records. evidence.list(project_id) -> {items:[...]}. signal.create(project_id,evidence_id,text) -> {id,project_id,evidence_id,text,status:OPEN}; signal.reject(project_id,signal_id,reason) persists status=REJECTED and reason; signal.list(project_id) -> {items:[...]}. Reject nonexistent/foreign evidence and blank signal text/rejection reason. Keep historical evidence bytes and source refs.

Current milestone M3:
Claim Ledger. claim.create(project_id,text,evidence_ids) -> {id,project_id,text,evidence_ids,status}; claim.get(project_id,claim_id) recomputes current validity; claim.list(project_id)->{items:[...]}; claim.conflict(project_id,claim_id,reason) marks CONFLICT with persistent reason. A grounded claim whose text is an actual substring of current imported evidence may be SUPPORTED. No evidence or a claim absent from cited evidence is UNSUPPORTED, never silently publishable. Superseded cited evidence yields STALE; explicit conflict yields CONFLICT. This deterministic baseline cannot manufacture inference as fact. Foreign/missing evidence IDs are rejected. Retain all source links and contradiction history. Do not modify prior modules.

Current milestone M6:
Approval. approval.review(project_id,content_id)->{content_id,revision,status:REVIEW}; approval.approve(project_id,content_id)->{content_id,revision,status:APPROVED}; approval.status(project_id,content_id)->{content_id,revision,status}. Approve only after review of the same current revision, with every claim currently SUPPORTED and every referenced media asset present/valid (media can be empty before M11). A semantic content.edit makes the current approval status DRAFT; old approval remains historical and cannot authorize new content. Reject unsupported/stale/conflicting claims, missing media, foreign content, and approve-before-review. Persist decisions and exact revision bindings. Downstream publication/scheduling must consult current validity, not a stale approved boolean.

Current milestone M7:
Local Publish and earliest usable GUI. publish.send(project_id,content_id,platform_url,idempotency_key)->receipt; publish.get(project_id,receipt_id)->receipt; publish.list(project_id)->{items:[receipts]}; publish.reconcile(project_id,receipt_id,platform_url)->receipt; publish.retry(project_id,receipt_id,platform_url)->receipt. Receipt includes id, project_id, content_id, revision, channel, status (PUBLISHED, RATE_LIMITED, UNKNOWN, FAILED), remote_id (null until known), idempotency_key, request_ref, response_ref, attempts:[{operation,status,started_at,ended_at}], url. Consult M6 approval and current claims/media before sending. POST platform_url+'/publish' JSON {idempotency_key,project_id,content_id,revision,channel,text}; response200 JSON {remote_id,url}. HTTP429 yields RATE_LIMITED, timeout/connection loss after request yields UNKNOWN (no blind retry). GET '/publications?key='+URL-encoded key reconciles: 200 {remote_id,url} confirms PUBLISHED; 404 proves absent, records that fact before retry can issue POST. Repeating a successful key must not send a second POST. Reusing key with changed revision/payload is rejected. Retry only the specified failed branch; successful siblings untouched. Different contents/channels can publish concurrently with safe persistent receipts and real interval overlap. Also supply serve_platform(host,port,data_dir): a real local threaded HTTP test platform with persistent idempotent /publish, /publications and /metrics?remote_id= routes, no upstream publishing. Include a separate early_main.py with usable browser GUI: Projects -> Campaign -> Content -> Review/Approve -> Local Publish -> Receipt, communicating with backend through POST /api/action {milestone:'M1'..'M7',...op request} and JSON response. It starts with python early_main.py --serve --port PORT --data DIR; no args shows help and exits0. GET /health returns JSON {status:'ok'}. Never proxy a static fake screen. Preserve this working early GUI as DOGFOOD_MVP before M8.

Successful creation shows the actual name; receipts visibly show remote IDs. Errors use role=alert and progress/result messages use role=status. A reload keeps selected persisted project data. Current milestone M8:
Scheduler. schedule.create(project_id,content_id,platform_url,when,idempotency_key)->{id,status:PENDING,when,...}; when is ISO8601 with timezone offset; reject naive timestamps and unapproved content. schedule.list(project_id)->{items:[...]}; schedule.cancel(project_id,schedule_id)->status CANCELLED; schedule.reschedule(project_id,schedule_id,when) keeps id and appends history; schedule.run_due(project_id,now)->{items:[processed schedule records]}. now is an explicit timezone-aware ISO8601 clock input for reproducible execution; GUI uses current UTC. Do not run future/cancelled tasks. For due tasks use M7, bind receipt_id and preserve PUBLISHED/RATE_LIMITED/UNKNOWN result. Restart and repeated run_due never duplicate successful publication. Unknown cannot silently become retryable. Rescheduling must not create an orphan duplicate job. Preserve successful siblings.
